E2 and E3 demonstrate Orowan strengthening from coherent nanoscale precipitates in a different alloy system (Al0.7CoCrFeNi), but provide no direct evidence for Al-induced B2 formation, the specific aging conditions, or density reduction in TaNbHfZrTi-based alloys. Thus, only one of the five key premises is directly supported by the cited evidence.
